The '''Restaurant Galatina''' was [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[44 ABY]], they were known to serve [[Membrosia/Legends|membrosia]] at a thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a liter.<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
